snippet.title: Bureau of Contacts teaser trailer
snippet.description:
As an agent of the bureau, it's your job to investigate paranormal entities. Learn the characteristics of a variety of ghosts and other supernatural phenomena to effectively confront them. Explore cursed locations on your own or with friends, each time in unique environments and new layouts from an extensive archive of hand-prepared rooms. The game cycle includes clear and sequential stages of investigation and exorcism, the success of which depends on effective teamwork and... your survival.
